AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Chatter is a Twitch chat client. Functions act on the channels in the user's Chatter list, as the Twitch account logged in to Chatter. Operational patterns: - Resolve a channel with 'listChannels' first and pass its login to 'openChannel' or 'sendChatMessage'. - 'listChannels' also answers which channels are live and where unread messages wait. Constraints: - 'sendChatMessage' posts publicly under the user's name; confirm the exact text with the user first. Twitch commands are refused. - Messages are limited to 500 characters.
